resources.string: Lets Android Dock detect a tap on the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar, and open the app switcher sheet.
Android Dock is not an app you open. After setup, tap the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar to switch apps. It needs a couple of permissions first.
All set. Tap the bottom-right corner of the navigation bar from any app.
Lets Android Dock notice a tap on the corner of the navigation bar. Find Android Dock in the list and switch it on.
If the switch is greyed out: open the app info page, tap the ⋮ menu and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Lets Android Dock see which apps you have used recently, to build the list of open apps.
